nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' holding the token name, set only in the constructor.
Public string state variable 'symbol' holding the token ticker symbol, set only in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' holding the token decimals (9), set only in the constructor.
Public uint256 state variable '_totalSupply', the maximum token supply, minted to the deployer.
Private mapping(address => uint) 'balances' tracking the token balance of each holder.
Private nested mapping 'allowed' tracking allowances: allowed[owner][spender].
Constructor: initializes name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and assigns the whole supply to msg.sender.
View function totalSupply() returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
View function balanceOf(address) returning balances[tokenOwner].
View function allowance(address,address) returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve(address,uint): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
transfer(address,uint): decrements balances[msg.sender] and increments balances[to] using SafeMath.
transferFrom(address,address,uint): moves tokens, decrementing balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender].
SafeMath safeAdd(uint,uint): a + b with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath safeSub(uint,uint): require(b <= a) then a - b underflow guard.
SafeMath safeMul(uint,uint): a * b with overflow guard require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath safeDiv(uint,uint): require(b > 0) then a / b.
msg.sender: caller controlled address used as mapping key and as authorization principal.
Balances subtraction inside transfer: balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens).
Balances/allowance subtraction inside transferFrom: safeSub(balances[from], tokens) and safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens).
Parameter 'spender' of approve(), the address granted the allowance.
Parameter 'tokens' of approve(), the allowance amount written to allowed.
Parameter 'to' of transfer(), the recipient whose balance is credited.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer(), the amount subtracted from msg.sender and added to 'to'.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom(), the account whose balances and allowance are debited.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(), the recipient credited with the tokens.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom(), the amount moved between accounts.
Local return variable 'c' of safeAdd() holding the sum a + b.
Local return variable 'c' of safeSub() holding the difference a - b.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mapping key when writing balances in the constructor and in transfer().
msg.sender is used as the spender key in allowed[from][msg.sender], i.e. it is the authorization principal for allowances.
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], so the caller identity directly controls the allowance entry.
transfer() debits balances[msg.sender]; the caller identity is the only authorization check.
transferFrom() debits allowed[from][msg.sender] without any explicit require, making msg.sender the sole access-control subject.
Constructor writes the constant 'NanaInu' into the name state variable.
Constructor writes the constant 'NINU' into the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes 9 into the decimals state variable.
Constructor assigns the initial supply to _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the entire _totalSupply to balances[msg.sender].
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply to compute its return value.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)] which is subtracted from _totalSupply.
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping for the given tokenOwner.
allowance() reads the nested allowed mapping.
approve() writes the supplied token amount into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer() mutates balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] using SafeMath arithmetic.
transferFrom() mutates balances[from] and balances[to] using SafeMath arithmetic.
transferFrom() decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] but never requires it to be >= tokens.
transfer() performs the balance subtraction guarded by safeSub, the arithmetic-sensitive operation.
transferFrom() performs the balance and allowance subtractions guarded by safeSub.
The subtraction result is written back to the balances mapping.
The subtraction results are written back to the balances mapping.
The allowance subtraction result is written back to the allowed mapping.
transfer() calls SafeMath.safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transfer() calls SafeMath.safeSub for the sender debit.
transferFrom() calls SafeMath.safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transferFrom() calls SafeMath.safeSub for the sender and allowance debits.
The spender parameter of approve() is used as the key of the allowed mapping.
The tokens parameter of approve() is the value stored in the allowed mapping.
The 'to' parameter of transfer() is used as the credited key in the balances mapping.
The tokens parameter of transfer() is the operand of the safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic.
The 'from' parameter of transferFrom() is debited without verifying that msg.sender is entitled to it.
The 'to' parameter of transferFrom() is used as the credited key in the balances mapping.
The tokens parameter of transferFrom() is the operand of the safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic.
The local sum variable c of safeAdd() is the result of the guarded addition.
The local difference variable c of safeSub() is the result of the guarded subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: The spender parameter is only meaningful as the allowance key written by approve().
The tokens parameter is only meaningful as the allowance value written by approve().
The 'to' parameter is only used as the credit key inside transfer().
The tokens parameter is only used as the arithmetic operand inside transfer().
The 'from' parameter is only used as the debit key inside transferFrom().
The 'to' parameter is only used as the credit key inside transferFrom().
The tokens parameter is only used as the arithmetic operand inside transferFrom().
The local return variable c only exists to carry the safeAdd() result.
The local return variable c only exists to carry the safeSub() result.
